description: Bootstrap and run initial Project-ELM369 tasks on Termux. Designed for interactive execution in Termux shell.

setup_steps.cmd: pkg install -y git python clang openssh curl rsync
python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

tasks.name: Initial Integrity Check
tasks.description: Verify cloned repo files and compute checksums for important files.
tasks.cmd: cd Project-ELM369 && sha256sum README.md PROJECT_METADATA.json > termux_initial_checksums.txt

tasks.name: NTP Sync (Geo-NTP Precision Sync)
tasks.description: Sync device clock to reliable NTP (may require root on some devices).

tasks.name: Install runtime Python deps
tasks.description: Install minimal Python packages used by the orchestrator and QA tools.
tasks.cmd: cd Project-ELM369 && pip install -r requirements-termux.txt || pip install requests cryptography psutil

tasks.name: Run lightweight diagnostics
tasks.description: Run a quick diagnostics script shipped in the repo (if present).
tasks.cmd: cd Project-ELM369 && python scripts/termux_diagnostics.py || echo 'No diagnostics script found. Skipping.'

tasks.name: Stage local vault logger snapshot
tasks.description: Create a local signed snapshot of key metadata files.
tasks.cmd: cd Project-ELM369 && tar -czf elm369_snapshot.tar.gz README.md PROJECT_METADATA.json && echo 'Signed-by: Esign Joseph Michael Rose 🌹' > snapshot.sig

safety.warning: Commands in this JSON may modify the local Termux environment. Review commands before executing. Committing personal data to public repos is irreversible without history rewrite.
safety.recommendation: Run commands interactively, validate each step, and backup device data before major operations.
